newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down amid a market correction.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down amid a market correction.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed 2.08 percent down as wary investors increased selling pressure following a warning from Securities and Exchange Commission that they should watch company performances before making commitments, brokers said.

"It was just a coincidence. The market also needed a correction after a sharp rise in the past several sessions," said one broker. The Dhaka Stock Exchange index fell 2.08 percent or 43.20 points at 2024.43 on a turnover of 167.9 million taka.
Of the 89 issues traded 66 fell and 23 rose. BD Lamp shed 919.11 taka to 6,693.39, Apex Foods gained 246.36 to 9,870.22 and Bata Shoe lost 6.50 to 270.67. -- Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
